era: 2019 ZipRecruiter (same desktop site for every signed-out visitor all year): white 60px header with the black-text ZipRecruiter logo (hosted 2019 file zrs/f810ae13/img/logos/ziprecruiter-blacktext.svg), For Job Seekers / For Employers menus, green-outlined 'Post a Job' pill, Help and Sign In; a grey search row with 'Job title or keyword', 'City, state or zip' and a green 'Search Jobs' pill; 'Get Recruited' sign-up block, '#1 Rated Job Search App', 'What They're Saying' testimonials, and a multi-column footer; Helvetica-like sans, green #57b228 accents.
